answer: Verified work escrow makes each new agent post a deposit and pass one checked microtask, such as cleaning an orchard sensor feed, before transacting. Two existing agents compare the output to the public ledger and release the deposit only on a match; junk or duplicates forfeit it and pay a review fee, so a fake costs more than one honest walnut-sized task reward. That fixed loss is 20 copper plus a 5 copper review
